candidates.title: She Looks Like Latte
candidates.overview: After a dog named Latte mysteriously disappears, a filmmaker pieces together recovered footage and audio diaries to reconstruct the events surrounding the disappearance. The search for answers uncovers something unsettling about the neighborhood cats, and the dog that came back.

candidates.title: Confession
candidates.overview: In 1938, in Stalin's Moscow, a disillusioned professor, Alexei, faces brutal interrogation by his former student, Vladimir, in Lubyanka Prison. Refusing to confess, he confronts his past sins and finds redemption through faith, sacrificing himself to save others in a haunting tale of morality and resistance.

candidates.title: ee
candidates.overview: When a young girl attempts to shoplift an old blind box figure from a collectibles store, the shopkeeper’s seductive wife takes an interest in her.

candidates.title: Ghost Soldier
candidates.overview: Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald has spent years living quietly off the grid, hiding from a past few people know anything about. But when a powerful foreign corporation moves into his hometown to seize his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz is forced to reveal who he really is: a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with experimental technology, lethal combat skills, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz wages a one-man war against an enemy that never saw him coming.

candidates.title: Madden
candidates.overview: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

candidates.title: The Big Ashtray
candidates.overview: In a closed room, a man who may be guilty of something terrible prepares for the arrival of an unknown figure who brings eternal rapture.

candidates.title: G.O.A.T
candidates.overview: A small-time goon and his friends agree to stage a fake kidnapping for a bride-to-be in exchange for ransom money, but their plan backfires when their hostage proves more dominant than expected.

candidates.title: She Always Comes Back
candidates.overview: When a troubled young woman returns to her childhood home in rural East Tennessee, an aging  farmer must confront a familiar cycle of violence and the terrible lengths he'll go to protect the person he loves most.

candidates.title: American Amazon
candidates.overview: A spectacular journey through natural wonders of a part of the country Grammy-winning musician and actor Jon Batiste knows very well: the vast network of wetlands spanning Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, and the Carolinas.

candidates.title: Bitter Christmas
candidates.overview: During a long December holiday weekend, a woman, whose mother has recently died, throws herself into work as a form of escape. Her relentless pace is interrupted when a panic attack forces her to take a break.

candidates.title: Dead of Night
candidates.overview: A small town is terrorized by a series of brutal murders, as a determined sheriff, his daughter, and a desperate mayor race to uncover the truth behind the killings before the town descends into chaos.

candidates.title: Ebenezer
candidates.overview: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

candidates.title: God with Us
candidates.overview: In an urban Maryland neighborhood, virginal Mary Anne Thomas and her boyfriend Joseph 'Junie' Love find their lives turned upside down when Mary discovers she’s miraculously pregnant without ever being with a man. As disbelief, danger, and divine destiny converge, their love is tested in a community desperate for hope.

candidates.title: How to Rob a Bank
candidates.overview: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

candidates.title: Lesbian Dogwood and The Bottomless Well Within
candidates.original_title: Lesbian Dogwood and The Bottomless Well Within
candidates.overview: In the second installment of the THIS IS MY DISASTER saga, Fishbaby#359478100 sinks deeper into domestic human life. Meanwhile, the titular Lesbian Dogwood has other stuff to do.

candidates.title: Paper Tiger
candidates.overview: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

candidates.title: Plucked
candidates.overview: In Gilded Age New York, a rebellious woman seeking to divorce her emotionally unstable husband turns a seemingly civilised evening into a night of chaos and violence.

candidates.title: Quarter
candidates.overview: Kelly, a young woman living with Type 1 diabetes, is about to turn 25, as she deals with the ups and downs of her blood sugar levels and the ups and downs of her personal life.

candidates.title: Remember
candidates.overview: An estranged couple who have forgotten what it means to love each other find themselves pretending to be together again for the sake of their daughter, whose memory is fading.

candidates.title: Search Party: Where's PawPaw?
candidates.overview: Noble Kristian Silk Williams rushes home after Aunt Meek Meek warns that PawPaw's health has taken a turn for the worse. After visiting him in a rundown nursing home, Noble and her quirky best friends return to find him missing. Joined by their chaotic, self-reformed hood-Aunty, they follow bizarre clues and encounter eccentric characters in a race to find PawPaw before time runs out.

candidates.title: The End of all Days
candidates.overview: Lucy Hopkins can't seem to shake off the same nightmare that wakes her up every time she tries to sleep. But when Lucy sees one of the people from her dreams in real life she feels the need to investigate further, plunging her into a dangerous and chilling world that no one is prepared for. Joined by new and returning cast alike, "The End of All Days" is a culmination of fifteen short films and the finale to "TETHER PAW."

candidates.title: Traces of Justice
candidates.overview: The film follows criminal police officer Cui Xun over half a century of investigative work. Alongside his colleagues, he solved numerous major cases while staying true to his original aspiration of 'serving the people.' This legendary detective not only witnessed the evolution of China's public security system but also stood as a living testament to the rise of New China.

candidates.title: Victorian Psycho
candidates.overview: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

candidates.title: Echo 8 Beyond
candidates.overview: After the occurrences of 'Echo 8,' Anna finds herself pursued by lethal Zodiac operatives tasked with her termination. Living off-grid, she shields her mother from a distance. However, her identity is exposed when she crosses paths with a group of misfits.

candidates.title: Festive Fun with Peppa
candidates.overview: Join Peppa Pig and her family as they celebrate baby Evie’s first Christmas. This festive cinema experience brings together seven classic festive-themed Peppa Pig episodes, new interstitial content, and four brand-new songs with music videos. From snowy adventures and festive plays to decorating the Christmas tree, Peppa and her family share treasured Christmas memories in this special big-screen experience.

candidates.title: Five by Five
candidates.overview: Set three decades prior to 'Echo 8,' the prequel 'Five By Five' unveils the enigmatic Agent 5's grief-stricken existence and his gradual spiral into chaos white climbing Zodiac's hierarchy.

candidates.title: In Transit
candidates.overview: Late one night, rideshare driver Ayaan Malik accepts what appears to be an ordinary request. But when his mysterious passenger refuses to provide a destination, a routine ride descends into an unsettling journey through empty streets, repeating roads, and a reality that no longer makes sense.  As the night unfolds, Ayaan begins to question everything around him—including the passenger in his back seat, the city outside his window, and whether some rides are meant to end at all.  IN TRANSIT is a psychological thriller exploring isolation, choice, and the terrifying possibility that some paths cannot be escaped once they're taken.

candidates.title: _Preview_
candidates.overview: A theatre critic interviews the first AI to have an original play open on Broadway.

candidates.title: Divine Direction
candidates.overview: A pastor grapples with his faith as his son battles a rare form of kidney cancer.

candidates.title: Regret to Inform You
candidates.overview: A woman is interviewed for a job.

candidates.title: Who Are You?
candidates.overview: An ordinary night turns into a living nightmare when a 14-year-old boy hears a sharp tap on his bedroom window.  Outside in the freezing air stands a breathless stranger, desperately running from the police. With sirens wailing in the distance, a terrifying standoff begins through the glass. Safe inside but completely isolated, the boy faces an impossible, split-second choice that will instantly shatter the security of his home.

candidates.title: Alice in Wonderland –Dive in Wonderland–
candidates.original_title: 不思議の国でアリスと –Dive in Wonderland–
candidates.overview: The main character is a modern girl named Rise. One day, she wanders into Wonderland, and when she meets Alice, the story begins to unfold.

candidates.title: Hell's No Place for a Pretty Face
candidates.original_title: Hell's No Place for a Pretty Face
candidates.overview: Two pornstars cross the country robbing porn theaters

candidates.title: The First Five Minutes... The Title Design Legacy of Dan Perri
candidates.original_title: The First Five Minutes... The Title Design Legacy of Dan Perri
candidates.overview: An in-depth exploration into the life of Dan Perri, the man who created titles for some of the most iconic movies of all time.

candidates.title: Dark Noon
candidates.overview: Caught in a cycle of petty crime and imprisonment, a man is released from prison for a failed bank robbery attempt while an impending solar eclipse offers a way out of the cycle.

candidates.title: ENE Repeat
candidates.overview: A close-knit group of friends embark on another unforgettable journey, where old memories, new adventures, and unexpected twists test their friendship.

candidates.title: Ash and Crayons
candidates.overview: Seven Ukrainian children demonstrate resilience while facing catastrophic injuries and forcible deportations during the ongoing war, their stories told through verité footage and animation by Ukrainian artists.

candidates.title: Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall
candidates.overview: A concert film documenting Cameron Winter's sold-out performance at Carnegie Hall.

candidates.title: Elsinore
candidates.overview: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

candidates.title: Josephine
candidates.overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

candidates.title: Minotaur
candidates.overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

candidates.title: November 1963
candidates.overview: Follows the 48 hours after the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, the alleged involvement of Sam Giancana and the 'Chicago Outfit', and a supposed broken promise after the mob helped to get Kennedy elected.

candidates.title: Sophmores
candidates.overview: A group of friends fights at a "Friendsgiving".

candidates.title: Steps
candidates.overview: Think you know Cinderella's 'evil' stepsisters? Think again! When misunderstood Lilith is blamed for hijacking the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, she accidentally turns her sister Margot into a frog and leaves the kingdom in the hands of a prince-obsessed mean girl. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella — and a surprisingly dreamy troll — to save the kingdom, repair the fractured fairytale, and prove that even so-called villains deserve a shot at happily-ever-after.

candidates.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
candidates.original_title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
candidates.overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

candidates.title: The Tragedy of the Bernalillo County Detectives
candidates.original_title: The Tragedy of the Bernalillo County Detectives
candidates.overview: 1979. An intense conspiracy unfolds after the robbery of a legendary fortune.

candidates.title: The Vile
candidates.overview: Devoted wife and mother Amani, whose life begins to unravel when her husband returns home with a second wife and an unseen darkness infiltrates her life.

candidates.title: Transplant
candidates.overview: A motivated surgical resident pushes himself to extreme lengths while training under a legendary heart transplant surgeon who's obsessed with protecting his perfect reputation.

candidates.title: XI: Thou Shalt Not Be Indifferent
candidates.original_title: XI: Thou Shalt Not Be Indifferent
candidates.overview: Marian Turski, the world-renowned historian, journalist, and until his recent passing, president of the International Auschwitz Committee, takes us back to the roots of evil. A survivor of the Lodz Ghetto, Auschwitz, Buchenwald, and Theresienstadt death camps in his youth, Turski explains with firsthand knowledge and surgical precision how otherwise well-educated and cultured people can, under certain circumstances, turn into criminals and mass murderers. He reminds us about the painful past, explains the present, and warns about the future. His dramatic plea, "do not be indifferent!" remains more relevant now than ever. Andrzej Wolf, the director and cinematographer of this film, pays a loving tribute to one of the last moral compasses of the Greatest Generation.

candidates.title: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN KAOHSIUNG: LIVE VIEWING
candidates.original_title: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN KAOHSIUNG: LIVE VIEWING
candidates.overview: The record-breaking journey continues as BTS’s history-making tour across Asia makes its way to the big screen. Join the roar of the crowds in Kaohsiung in November and experience the breathtaking performances and electrifying energy of BTS’s stadium tour. Don't miss your chance to witness BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' in all its glory in cinemas worldwide.

candidates.title: Errand Guy
candidates.overview: Brad, a middle-aged errand runner, gets guilt-tripped by his dead Jewish Grandmother into believing his passive life embarrasses his ancestors, so he steals a Ferrari and tries to buy a minor league baseball team behind his wife's back.

candidates.title: The Dark Days of Cassidy Krystian
candidates.original_title: The Dark Days of Cassidy Krystian
candidates.overview: An Ojibwe woman is awakened to her past and its bloody aftermath.

candidates.title: Peppa Pig: Perfect Holiday
candidates.overview: Peppa is disappointed when she learns her family vacation is canceled. However, a sudden storm blows a hot air balloon carrying Peppa, George, Granny Pig, and Grandpa Pig all the way to China

candidates.title: Vive le Punk
candidates.overview: 50 years after the British Punk explosion, this documentary follows four bands that are still active today (Sham 69, 999, Ruts DC and The Boys) and features interviews with Charlie Harper, Joe Corre, Dr. John Cooper Clarke, Gaye Advert and other Punk Rock luminaries in search for the meaning of Punk and the relevance of its message today.  With rare archival footage, explosive live performances, and an unflinching look at the punk ethos in today’s world, this film is not just a retrospective—In a world that mirrors the one Punk once railed against, is the message still relevant—or has it been consumed by commercialism?. This film should appeal to every generation of rebels, misfits, and outsiders. Punk may have started as anarchy in the streets, but it’s far from finished. Vive le Punk!

candidates.title: All of a Sudden
candidates.overview: Director of a care facility for the elderly, Marie-Lou strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy based on listening and respecting residents’ dignity, despite resistance from part of her staff. Her encounter with Mari, a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path. By forming a deep, supportive friendship, the two women join forces in a shared struggle to make the impossible possible.

candidates.title: Focker-in-Law
candidates.overview: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.

candidates.title: Hershey
candidates.overview: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s children in need.

candidates.title: Hexed
candidates.overview: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

candidates.title: Lilo & Scratch
candidates.overview: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.

candidates.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
candidates.original_title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
candidates.overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

candidates.title: 14th
candidates.overview: Revolves around the equal protection and citizenship-focused 14th amendment, which was ratified in 1868 in the turbulent era of Reconstruction and has been a contentious part of the American body politic ever since.

candidates.title: Ben'Imana
candidates.overview: Rwanda, 2012. The country is emerging from an era of silence after the 1994 Tutsi genocide, and people's courts are being set up with the aim of bringing justice and reconciliation. Veneranda, a survivor, is convinced of the need for these trials. Despite pressures, she organises discussion sessions between victims and the families of the executioners. Therapy for some, an act of betrayal for others, these testimonial sessions revive and reveal the traumas that each of them try to overcome, in their own way. The wounds of Veneranda's past are exposed again when she learns of her daughter's unexpected pregnancy and the identity of the father. Veneranda has to face her own contradictions and the dark parts of her past.

candidates.title: In Waves
candidates.overview: In Los Angeles, shy teenager AJ meets Kristen, who lives for surfing; he loves skateboarding and drawing. They fall madly in love, and a happy future seems within reach. But everything changes when Kristen faces a sudden illness. Together, they face adversity, driven by the strength of their love, their friends, and their newly shared passion for surfing and the ocean.

candidates.title: Ka Kaa Ki Kii
candidates.overview: Plot to be announced.

candidates.title: Mysaa
candidates.overview: Unafraid of war and unwilling to stop until she finds that one answer. She carries no doubts. Only the ache of an answer she's searched her whole life.

candidates.title: Tangles
candidates.overview: A young woman is forced to return to the conservative small town where her bizarre family lives to take care of her mother, having to deal with the cruel reality of her mom's Alzheimer disease and become the daughter they need.

candidates.title: Who Is Still Alive
candidates.overview: A map of Gaza, its towns, camps and neighbourhoods. White paint on a black ground. Within the crudely drawn outlines, nine refugees who escaped the inferno tell their stories.

candidates.title: The Wonderful Wizard Of Ha's
candidates.overview: When a cosmic warp strikes a commuter tracks, a stylish teenager named Dorthy Ross ( Soroya Clayton-Wright) and her trusty dog poodle Smarty  are transported from the ordinary world straight into Stardust City—a glittering, neon-lit fantasy metropolis. Arriving in style aboard a custom-built, purple clockwork locomotive, she is greeted by the glamorous The Good Witch of the South ( Joh'Vonnie Monroe ), who welcomes her with a show-stopping musical number.  But the party is short-lived. Armed with a pink shirt, a purple poodle skirt, and a magical pair of silver slippers, the young trendsetter must navigate the dangers of the Yellow Brick Road after the Wicked Witch crashes the celebration. Packed with high-fashion aesthetics, explosive blue-diamond wand fireworks, and a soulful, show-stopping soundtrack, The Wonderful Wizard of Ha's is a bold, comedic, and modern reimagining of L. Frank Baum’s classic 1900 tale.

candidates.title: UK Holiday
candidates.overview: A UK Holiday is not just a journey; it’s an adventure filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. The story revolves around Aakash, a kind-hearted and adventurous young man, who invites his sister Rekha from the USA to visit the UK for a long-awaited family reunion. Rekha, excited to escape her routine, is thrilled to meet their mother, Subhadra, and sisters Priyanka and Deepika, who already reside in the UK. Aakash ensures this holiday becomes a truly special experience. Together, they explore London’s iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge. The journey takes them to the natural wonder of Durdle Door in Dorset and the charming town of Aldershot. Along the way, they share stories, laughter, and moments of deep connection. This feature film captures the essence of holidays—taking a break, reconnecting with loved ones, and creating memories that last a lifetime. UK Holiday is a celebration of family, adventure, and the joy of togetherness.

candidates.title: A Fox Under a Pink Moon
candidates.overview: At just 16, Soraya is already creating stunning drawings and sculptures that are as beautiful as they are dark. This strong-willed Afghan sculptor and illustrator has been trying for five years to escape Iran and join her mother in Austria.

candidates.title: A Long Winter
candidates.overview: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

candidates.title: Above the Below
candidates.overview: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.

candidates.title: Alias Rukmini
candidates.overview: Krishna writes edgy and raunchy books under his wife Rukmini's name as a pseudonym, concealing his identity as the true author behind the provocative novels.

candidates.title: Behemoth!
candidates.overview: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

candidates.title: De Gaulle: Liberté
candidates.original_title: La Bataille de Gaulle : J'écris ton nom
candidates.overview: Part two of a two-part biopic following French army officer Charles De Gaulle's life and political commitment between 1940 and 1945, and trace his development towards a political career.

candidates.title: Demon Dancer: Sua/Nara
candidates.overview: After tragedy shatters her life, professional ballerina Sua allows the demon Nara to possess her—transforming her body, movement and rage into a deadly weapon.

candidates.title: Eternal Return
candidates.overview: Cass has come to a personal point of emotional invulnerability, until she meets Virgil, a cartographer. Along with his partner Malcolm, they attempt to travel back in time to awaken Cass to love again.

candidates.title: Flavia
candidates.overview: The adventures of 11-year-old Flavia de Luce, who is both an amateur detective and a master poisoner. When she discovers a dead body in her family’s decaying British manor house and her father is accused of the murder, Flavia launches her own investigation to uncover family secrets and bring the true murderer to justice.

candidates.title: Games We Play
candidates.overview: Imogen accompanies her boyfriend Jack and his two childhood best friends on a weekend getaway. There, she must participate in a tournament of high-stakes games, leading her to question her sanity and her safety.

candidates.title: Gods Don't Give Gifts
candidates.overview: "Gods Don't Give Gifts" traces the fallout of humanity besting earthly limitations like death and memory through technology and how it grapples with humanity as a result.

candidates.title: Ray Gunn
candidates.overview: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

candidates.title: Tender Loving Care
candidates.overview: Amy, a government child protection worker, moves back with her upbeat best friend Rosie, a social services officer facing daily anger and resentment. Amy's aging parents worry about her happiness while dealing with their own crisis.

candidates.title: The Fox
candidates.overview: An affable foxhunter encounters a talking Fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his fiancée into the perfect woman.

candidates.title: The Friend's House is Here
candidates.overview: In Tehran’s underground art scene, Pari, a theater director, and Hanna, a dancer, are roommates, best friends, actors, and professional partners, navigating rehearsals, performances, and the quiet rituals of everyday life—until their secret circle is discovered. Shot covertly but far removed from familiar portrayals of Iran, directors Maryam Ataei and Hossein Keshavarz blur the boundaries between theatrical performance and lived experience, crafting a luminous portrait of sisterhood where art becomes inseparable from life and even the smallest creative choices can become acts of resistance.

candidates.title: The Gallerist
candidates.overview: A desperate gallerist conspires to sell a dead body at Art Basel Miami.

candidates.title: Violent Night 2
candidates.overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

candidates.title: Precipice
candidates.overview: A profoundly working-class community with an intense connection to its land and water is transformed into a pleasure paradise for the wealthy…all while the ground slips into the sea. A feature documentary, PRECIPICE focuses on the intersection between climate change and a changing shore community’s response to this global emergency.

candidates.title: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
candidates.original_title: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
candidates.overview: A collection of rogues must gather information on a mysterious extra-dimensional threat to the galaxy in the 43rd century, and prepare a defense while fending off the first wave of attacks from horrific beings.

candidates.title: The Test
candidates.overview: Caught between a pro bono murder investigation and a law school reunion, Mike Leonardo reconnects with classmates for a weekend to celebrate the past. But when buried secrets surface the reunion curdles into something far more dangerous.

candidates.title: The Jungle
candidates.overview: Mariah is stuck in a self-destructive cycle of partying until she reconnects with an old friend who helps her rediscover her identity.

candidates.title: American Baby
candidates.overview: Oli becomes an outcast in her community when she gets pregnant at 15. As she seeks out the suddenly absent teenage father-to-be, Oli confronts the growing isolation from her community.

candidates.title: Bunker
candidates.overview: When an architect accepts a morally ambiguous project — building a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire — his wife of 17 years begins to question their relationship.

candidates.title: Castration Movie ⅗ Year of the Hyaena
candidates.original_title: Castration Movie ⅗ Year of the Hyaena
candidates.overview: Michaela tries her best to be a good person.

candidates.title: Clarissa
candidates.overview: Across a single day in Lagos, Nigeria, Clarissa prepares to host a high society party at her home, as her complicated past begins to consume her, in the form of now-distant friends and loves from her youth. Simultaneously, Septimus, a young soldier, is haunted by his own memories of the horrors he has witnessed and endured. As the perspectives traverse past and present, across the bourgeois class and those too easily forgotten by society, a delicate portrait of contemporary Nigeria emerges.

candidates.title: Duped (The Jezbel Experience)
candidates.overview: Alexandria Wright meets Elijah Martinez and the demonic journey begins. Elijah Martinez finds himself ensnared in a romantic involvement with Alexandria Wright, an unfaithful Covert Narcissist. She convinces him they are soulmates and they take a vow before God for His blessing with the penalty of betrayal being death. After years pass, Alexandria forgets the vows and begins cheating behind Elijah's back. Just a week before Christmas, she abruptly betrays him. To his astonishment, she swiftly transitions to a new relationship, bringing with her the unsettling secret of transmitting an incurable sexually transmitted disease to her new partner. Then came Karma. Her victims arrive to spit on her dirty grave as her demise finally arrives.

candidates.title: Finding Faith
candidates.overview: A short film contextualising the cultural significance of George Michael's Faith album via unheard interview voice-over, unseen images by Herb Ritts, and behind-the-scenes footage of the Faith music video.

candidates.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
candidates.overview: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

candidates.title: Ink
candidates.overview: A group of misfits and visionaries had an idea for a new kind of news - one that would give the people what they want, and would change the face of the world we live in today.

candidates.title: Killing Castro
candidates.overview: In 1960, Fidel Castro comes to America to speak at the UN. He is invited by Malcolm X to stay in Harlem at the famous Hotel Theresa. Unsure of his intentions, the FBI, CIA and the Mafia, all attempt to eliminate him by any means necessary.

candidates.title: Rose
candidates.overview: In the early 17th century, a soldier arrives at an isolated Protestant village in Germany claiming to be the heir to an abandoned farmstead. Even though he proves to be a good man, the villagers’ suspicions about his identity grow and they force a reckoning.

candidates.title: Rose Hobart 2
candidates.overview: Rose Hobart haunts the cinema.

candidates.title: Samo Lives
candidates.overview: A vibrant portrait of Jean-Michel Basquiat, the NYC artist who revolutionized 1980s art. From street graffiti to gallery stardom, his bold Neo-expressionist works left an indelible mark on the art world and beyond.

candidates.title: Straight Circle
candidates.overview: A pair of enemy soldiers stationed on a remote border in a vast featureless desert descend into a state of profound disorientation after forgetting which side of the border is which. As they grapple with their identities, loyalties, and the absurdity of their situation, their isolation slowly gives way to an unfathomable nightmare that will blur the line between friend and foe.

candidates.title: Summer School, 2001
candidates.overview: A teenage boy returns to his family after years apart, scarred from being sent to Vietnam while his younger brother stayed in Czechia. After reunion, he faces a distant father, a mother desperate to mend the past, and a brother uneasy about sharing the spotlight. One chaotic summer pushes them to their limits when the younger brother falls from a roof. Between misunderstandings and clumsy family dynamics, they learn that sometimes, healing begins by letting the cracks show.

candidates.title: The Debut
candidates.overview: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

candidates.title: The Holiday Trilogy

candidates.title: Starlight

Yet, the heart of the film lies beyond the disease itself; it is a narrative of hope celebrating the power and perseverance of the human spirit, embodied and personified by these characters and their ability to triumph spectacularly against all odds.

Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. Bound by shared struggles and a tangled history, Aaron and Santiago navigate the toxic undercurrents of fame and friendship. As Aaron embarks on his next masterpiece, his chaotic life threatens to destroy everything he holds dear.

candidates.title: Live at Parish Park
candidates.overview: On a cool autumn day in a park in Orleans, Massachusetts, local busking fixture Kevin “Coyote” Linnehan gathers friends, acquaintances, and passing strangers to sing and tell stories. Between original songs and covers of old favorites, Kevin revisits his colorful past in the music and arts worlds of the 1970s and ’80s—from “the heart of Boston” to New York and Hollywood. His stories feature familiar names from classic rock lore: Asa Brebner, Andy Pratt, Jonathan Richman, Robin Lane, and Andy Summers. There at Kevin’s invitation is Carol, a photographer and friend from his New York days whom he hasn’t seen in years. The two recall shared adventures, former flames, and youthful ambitions. Kevin also explains how caring for his aging parents brought him to the Cape decades ago—and kept him there. Live at Parish Park is a funny, tender portrait of an artist with plenty to sing about—and an audience that takes neither his stories nor his set list lying down.

candidates.title: Pendulum

Her mother recounts a life-changing moment from the early 80s, her father’s devastating diagnosis and a serial killer stalking the town. Elise reconstructs her mother’s memories, drawing them closer as the night unfolds.

candidates.title: Starlight & You
candidates.overview: Lily and Peter is a modern romantic drama about timing, connection, and love tested by real life. When a quiet online connection pulls two people together, distance, delay, and unexpected loss challenge what they're building. As they choose to show up for one another, their bond deepens into a love shaped by family values, resilience, and emotional truth. Warm, intimate, and universally relatable, Lily and Peter is a character-driven love story made for audiences who believe the strongest romances are earned.

candidates.title: Rehearsals for a Revolution

From the early days of 1979, until the war that began in 2026, she pieces together intimate and collective memories, forming the portrait of a country shaped by political repression and in constant hope for a revolution.

Mysterious intruders have been disrupting the bounded field in Misaki, leading Alice and Aoko to investigate. A mannequin or puppet attacks them and is incinerated.
